content: Tɔmbu bɑ rɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ dɑbinu niɑ ko, ɑdɑmɑ Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u yen kɔkɔrɔ yɛ̃.
Tɔnun sɑnu sɑnusu su rɑ n dɛndewɑ win tiin nɔni sɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ Gusunɔwɑ u rɑ nùn wɛ̃ɛri.
A Yinni Gusunɔ wunɛn sɔmɑ kpuro nɔmu sɔndio, kpɑ ye ɑ niɑ sɑ̃ɑ kpuro yu nun koorɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u kpuro kuɑ win himbɑ yu kɑ yibiɑrɑ, sere mɑm kɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobɔ, be u koo kɑm koosiɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u ku rɑ tii suo kɑ̃. U koo nùn sɛɛyɑsiɑwɑ kɑm kɑm.
À n mɔ̀ dee dee, mɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɑɑnɛɡii, Yinni Gusunɔ u koo nun wunɛn torɑnu suuru kuɑ. À n nùn nɑsie, kpɑ u nun kɔ̃sɑ kpuro ɡbɑrɑ.
Tɔnun dɑɑ yɑ̀ n Yinni Gusunɔ wɛ̃re, u rɑ de bu dorɑ wi kɑ win yibɛrɛbɑ mɑm.
N sɑnɔ ɑ n dukiɑ fiiko mɔ kpɑ yɑ n dɛɛre, kɑ sere ye kɑɑ n kɑ dukiɑ bɑkɑ mɔ kɑ keetɑ.
Tɔnu u rɑ niɑ ko ye u kĩ, ɑdɑmɑ Gusunɔwɑ u rɑ win sɑnu sɑnusu kpɑre.
Mɔn ni nu kɑ sinɑmbu yɑ̃
Sinɑ boko u rɑ ɡɑri kowɑ kɑ Gusunɔn yiiko. Yen sɔ̃nɑ win siribu bu rɑ n sɑ̃ɑ dee dee.
Kilo kɑ yĩirutii ni nu sɑ̃ɑ dee dee yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kĩ. Wiyɑ u rɑ sɔ̃ɔsi nɡe mɛ bɑ koo ye dendisinɑ.
Sinɑ boko kun wurɑmɔ bu kɔ̃sɑ ko, domi ɡemɑ mu koo de win bɑndu tɑ n tɑ̃sɑ.
Gemɑ sinɑ boko u rɑ kɑ̃. U rɑ kɑ̃wɑ bu nùn ɡem sɔ̃.
Sinɑ bokon mɔru yɑ̀ n seewɑ, u koo kpĩ u ɡoo ɡɔɔ bɔrie, ɑdɑmɑ bwisiɡii u koo nùn kɔkiri u mɑrisiɑ.
Sinɑ boko ù n nuku dobu mɔ, win tɔmbun hunde yɑ koo dɑkɑɑ dɑ. Ù n mɑɑ ɡoo durom kuɑ, yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe ɡurɑ ye yɑ nɑ ɡbeburun sɑɑ.
Wɑ̃ɑsinɑɑ kɑ tii nɛnubu
Tɔnu ù n bwisi kɑ lɑɑkɑri mɔ, n wɑ̃ n kere ù n wurɑ kɑ sii ɡeesu mɔ.
Gemɡii u rɑ kɔ̃sɑ dukɑ suuriwɑ. Wi u win sɑnu sɑnusu lɑɑkɑri sɑ̃ɑ, u rɑ win wɑ̃ɑru nɔni dokewɑ.
Fɑɑri yɑ rɑ tɔmbu surewɑ. Tii suɑbu bu rɑ kɑ kɑm kobu nɛwɑ.
N burɑm bo ɑ tii kɑwɑ kpɑ ɑ n sɑ̃ɑ bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛ, ye kɑɑ n kɑ bɑɑ mɔ tii suobun ɑrumɑni sɔɔ.
Wi u rɑ bwisiku u sere ɡɑ̃ɑnu ko, u rɑ kuurewɑ. Mɛyɑ wi u mɑɑ Yinni Gusunɔ nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ, u rɑ n nuku dobu mɔ.
Wi u rɑ siri kɑ lɑɑkɑri, u bwisi mɔwɑ. Gɑri yi bɑ ɡeruɑ kɑ kĩru, yiyɑ yi rɑ tɔmbu kɑmiɛ.
Wi u bwisi dendimɔ yi koo nùn wɑ̃ɑru wɛ̃, kpɑ bu ɡɑri bɔkɔ sɛɛyɑsiɑ ɡen ɡɑri bɑkɑrun sɔ̃.
Be bɑ bwisi mɔ bɑ rɑ ɡɑri kowɑ kɑ lɑɑkɑri, kpɑ ben ɡɑri yi, yi tɔmbu kɑmiɑ.
Gɑri dori yi sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe tim ɡɔm mɛ mu dim do, mu rɑ mɑɑ wɑsi dɑm sosie.
Tɔnu u rɑ n tɑmɑɑ win sɑnu sɑnusu su wɑ̃wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɔɔwɑ sin kɔkɔrɔ.
Gɔ̃ɔrɑ tɑ rɑ de tɔnu u win sɔmburu sɔɔ hɑniɑ sosi, domi u kĩ win ɡɔ̃ɔru tu kpe.
Tɔnu kɑm, kɔ̃sɑ u rɑ n bwisikumɔ, kpɑ yɑ n yɑrimɔ win nɔɔn di nɡe dɔ̃ɔ.
Tɔn kɔ̃so u rɑ sikirinɔsu seeyewɑ. Tɔn wĩɔ u rɑ mɑɑ bɔrɔbɑ kɑrɑnɛwɑ.
Dɑɑ bɔɔbɔyɑɡii u rɑ tɔnu nɔni wɔ̃kewɑ, kpɑ u nùn sure swɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ sɔɔ.
Wi u nɔni yinwɑ mɑ u nɔɔ tɛndu bɛri u kɑ kɔ̃sɑ ko, u ye kuɑ kɔ.
Seri kpiki yi sɑ̃ɑwɑ bɛɛrɛ bɑkɑ, domi wi u ɡem swĩi, wiyɑ u rɑ yi wɑ.
Wi u kpĩɑ u win mɔru kɑmiɑ, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbu durɔ kɑ ɡem. Wi u kpĩɑ u tii nɛnuɑ, u kere tɑbu durɔ wi u wuu bɔkɔ kɑmiɑ.
Sɔrobu bɑ rɑ yɑnim so bu kɑ wɑ ye n koo tɔnu deemɑ, ɑdɑmɑ Yinni Gusunɔ turowɑ u yɛ̃ ye n koo koorɑ siɑ.
